summary: Frontend-only retest after iteration 10. The /strand/5 no-scroll fix works. At every size, scrollHeight equals innerHeight and next-remembers-button is fully visible: 1280x720 (button 621-677, so-far-tags hidden), 1366x768 (645-701, tags hidden), 1440x900 (764-820, tags shown), 1920x1080 (854-910, tags shown). Answering strands 1-4 by clicking (no seed) at 1280x720 also reached /strand/5 with no scroll (button bottom 676), and the CTA goes to /strand/6. At 1280x720 these also fit: /strand/1 (720/720, CTA bottom 678), /strand/6 (720/720, CTA bottom 643), /strand/7 (720/720, CTA bottom 678) and /bands (720/720, weave-him-button 501-557). Meet /meet/a5yxsmhb at 390x844 and 1280x800: taps cycle blush>hearts>kiss>sigh>shy>smile>wink with 0 console errors. data-emotion=hearts shows pink heart irises at opacity 1. Each iris is 11x7px at 390 and 17x11px at 1280. They read clearly as hearts at 1280. At 390 they clearly differ from idle (pink hearts vs dark irises), but they are still small.

issues: The heart irises (now scale 1.5) are about 11x7px on a phone. They are visible and pink, but the heart shape is only just readable at 1x. Optional: scale about 1.8 or add a brief pop/glow.
At height <= 820 the 'so far he's woven from' tags are hidden entirely, so short-window users lose that recap. This is acceptable as a trade-off.

action_items: Optional: make the heart irises a little larger again for phones (about scale 1.8).
critical_code_review_comments: index.css: the short-desktop rule targets [data-testid=so-far-tags] and [data-testid^=slider-card-] by test id. It works, but it couples styling to test ids. A dedicated class would be more robust.
index.css: there are two separate '@media (min-width:1024px) and (max-height:820px)' blocks. They could be merged.
seed_data_creation: None. Used sessionStorage 'weave-him-answers' seed for direct navigation, plus one real click-through of strands 1-4.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Strand CTAs: weave-strand-button (1-4,7), next-remembers-button (5), next-feel-button (6), weave-him-button (/bands). /bands needs a full answers seed, otherwise it redirects to /strand/1.
